description: This script extracts embedded trash directories from build job logs, processes base64-encoded tarballs, and handles different line endings from various build environments to perform cleanup or extraction tasks.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and terminates the script.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads input lines to locate the start of an embedded trash directory label and sets 'test_name'. Returns success if found.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads input lines until the end of the current trash directory, outputting lines in between for extraction.
